_source: Written by an AI agent on 2026-11-13 from its own knowledge: notable universities outside the UK and the US, grouped by country (national flagships and institutions that a UK or US student would recognise, plus well-known business schools and institutes of technology). NOT downloaded from an official list and not checked against one (for example a QS or Times Higher Education ranking, or a national register). It is a starting point: the owner should review it or replace it with an official source. Names, aliases and email domains were left out when not certain; a short name that more than one university uses was left out too. Non-English institutions are listed under the English name commonly used abroad, or the home-language name where that is how they are known. A missing institution is never a problem, because people can type their own.
_fields: id is a stable slug of the name (with the country code added only where two institutions share a name, in any of the files) and must never change once released; aliases are short names and acronyms; domains are email domains (a subdomain such as students.example.ca also matches); country is an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code and countries maps each code used here to its English name.
